changelog_1_0_22_release_dialog: Added a release notes dialog that appears once after a plugin update.
changelog_1_0_22_manual_entry: Added a What's New button so release notes can be opened again at any time.
changelog_1_0_21_split_data: Separated improvement list data from detailed route data and enabled independent data updates.
changelog_1_0_21_route_tables: Improvement routes with different materials, costs, or upgrade targets are now shown in separate tables.
changelog_1_0_21_tamanami: Added support for Tamanami Kai Ni's assistant-specific improvement material route.
changelog_1_0_23_data_package: Improvement data now comes from the versioned @sakura2333/kancolle-data package.
changelog_1_0_23_no_runtime_sync: Removed runtime GitHub synchronization; data is installed together with the plugin through npm.
changelog_1_0_23_shared_icons: Use-item PNG assets are now shared through the data package by both official and beta plugins.
